prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied NPC concept sheet for a revised visual approval mockup. Preserve its detailed hand-painted retro fantasy rendering, warm light, material textures, character identity, exact wardrobe and colors, and layout: four full standing cardinal views (front, screen-left profile, back, screen-right profile) and one larger expression portrait at right. Preserve transparent background, full bodies, same scale and baseline, clear gutters. No labels, text, extra figures, props or scenery. Apply the requested anatomical revision coherently to all views including portrait. This is a targeted refinement, not a new character design.
Requested revision: Balin stays a short stocky teenage human guard, broad shoulders, round head, oversized pot helmet, patched brown vest and worn mail. Keep vacant good-natured dim grin and slightly asymmetric features, but substantially reduce exaggerated ugliness. Keep a visible MILD underbite; reduce jutting chin and jaw and protruding lip, with a modest slack open smile rather than hugely stretched mouth. Teeth normal-sized and mostly intact, slight crookedness and at most one small gap, no isolated oversized pegs, no rotten mouth. Eyes basically aligned with only subtle natural asymmetry and unfocused expression, not severely divergent or bulging. Natural youthful face, softer cheek creases, plausible neck and jaw. Mildly comic unpolished human rather than a grotesque caricature or monster.
